text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

COAL - QUEENSLAND, Sept 9 - Abbot Point - berth vacant, 11 vessels due by 6/10, no delays. Dalrymple Bay - one vessel loading, 1 waiting, 17 due by 10/10. Approx 1 days delay expected. Hay Point - berth no.1 due to re-open 18/9. One vessel loading, 3 waiting, 13 due by 24/9. Approx 2-3 days delay expected. Gladstone - R.G. Tanna 2 vessels loading, 5 waiting, 18 due by 25/9. Approx 2-3 days delay expected. Barney Point shutdown to upgrade terminals, plant and equipment until 25 Oct. No shiploading/trainloading. Brisbane - one vessel loading, 4 due by 19/9, no delays.

NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Port Waratah coal terminal operations disrupted by industrial dispute. Shiploading ceased at pw5 at 1258 hrs and at pw4 at 1244 hrs. Earliest return to work 1500 hrs 10/9. Kooragang coal loader unaffected. Dykes 4+5 2 vessels loading, 6 waiting, 14 due by 19/9. Approx 6-7 days delay expected. Kooragang coal loader will have one shiploader and one reclaimer out of commission for repairs for 23 days from 14/9. Two vessels loading, 6 waiting, 10 due by 20/9. Approx 3-4 days delay expected. Port Kembla - one vessel loading, 1 waiting, 12 due by 15/10. 1-2 days delay.

IRON ORE, WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Port Hedland - BHP iron ore Mt. Newman (Nelson Point), A berth 1 vessel loading, 1 anchored, 6 due by 18/9. B berth 1 vessel loading, 2 anchored, 5 due by 20/9, 1 other vessel due by 29/9. BHP iron ore Goldsworthy (Finucane Island) 1 vessel loading, 2 due by 14/9. Dampier - Parker Point 1 vessel loading, 2 due by 11/9. East Intercourse Island 1 vessel loaded, 3 due by 16/9. Dampier line-up 8 vessels due by 26/9 of which 4 for Parker Point, 4 for East Intercourse island. Port Walcott - nine vessels due by 26/9.

GRAIN, QUEENSLAND, Sept 11 - Mackay - no vessels due. Expected winter grain export from Mackay reduced to approx. 40/50,000 MT due to recent frost. Shipments expected November/December '96. Gladstone - two vessels due by 25/10 of which 1 to load wheat, 1 sorghum. Brisbane - one vessel due 25/9 to load sorghum.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - one vessel loading wheat, vessels due by 30/9 to load wheat. Port Kembla - four vessels due by October, all to load wheat.
VICTORIA - Geelong - one vessel waiting to load barley, 5 vessels due by mid-October, all to load wheat. Portland - three vessels due by 23/9 of which 2 to load peas, 1 wheat.

SOUTH AUSTRALIA - Port Pirie - one vessel loading wheat, 1 at anchor waiting to load wheat, 1 due 21/9 to load wheat. Port Adelaide - one vessel anchored waiting to load wheat, 4 due by 20/9 of which 3 to load wheat, 1 canola. Thevenard - one vessel due 14/9 to load wheat. Port Lincoln - two vessels due by 25/9, both to load wheat. Wallaroo - one vessel due 16/9 to load peas. Ardrossan, Port Giles - no vessels due.

WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Geraldton - one vessel loading wheat, 1 waiting to load 2, vessels due by 16/9, to load wheat. Kwinana - one vessel loading barley, 1 waiting to load wheat, 5 due by 16/9, all to load wheat. Loading terminal continues to operate with only one day shift Monday-Friday due to industrial dispute. Albany - one loading oats, 1 waiting to load barley, 2 due by 20/9 to load wheat. Esperance - one due 15/9 to load wheat.
